scope: Prevent combining G09 child checks that each require a pristine disposable placeholder-only database.

change.behavior: The harness rejects more than one pristine-database fixture check before Docker setup, with instructions to run one fixture flag per fresh-cluster invocation.

negativePreflight.result: rejected before Docker setup with the expected pristine-placeholder-only database message

limits: This validates fixture orchestration only; it is not new product acceptance evidence.
It does not close G09 source revocation, trusted production identity, independent quality review, or final activation transaction gates.
